IGUI_perks_PlayItMusic_Description: Gained by playing an instrument. The higher the level, the fewer wrong notes, and the more your playing cheers up the people listening.
IGUI_PlayIt_BadName: Use letters, digits, spaces, - or _ in the name.
IGUI_PlayIt_NotHolding: Hold the instrument in your main hand to play.
IGUI_PlayIt_Warn_NotAbc: This isn't an ABC song: it needs an X: line and a K: line before the notes.
IGUI_PlayIt_Warn_TooManyNotes: This part has more than %1 notes; only the first %1 play.
IGUI_PlayIt_TooLong: This part is too long to share with other players (at most 10,000 notes). Pick a shorter part or cut some bars.
IGUI_PlayIt_TooFar: Get closer to the instrument to play.
IGUI_PlayIt_NoSticks: You need a drumstick to play the drums.
IGUI_PlayIt_Busy: Someone else is already playing this.
IGUI_PlayIt_Along_PlayingAlongReady: Playing along with %1. Press Play when ready.
IGUI_PlayIt_Along_TooFar: Too far away to play along.
IGUI_PlayIt_Along_TargetLeft: The player you wanted to play along with left.
